title: Guggenheim/Quotes
summary:
"Hello, everyone. I trust you're enjoying the afternoon. How does a trip to the wilds of Scandinavia sound? Iceland, I should say." (Guggenheim)

"Sounds cold." (Dante Vale, The Legacy of Thor)

"The Foundation cannot officially support this recklessness."
- Guggenheim to Dante Vale (The Divine Comedy)
